itemized.escalation_note: p4 and p5 each re-rendered as four 600dpi band crops - left block (date+lastname+firstname, pct:9,12.5,27,39 / pct:9,51,27,39 on p4 and pct:9,12.5,27,35 / pct:9,46.5,27,35 on p5) and right block (occupation+amount, pct:66,... and pct:68.5,...). itemized.notes: 7-page filing: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed), p3 printed Schedule A form, pp4-5 the filer's TYPED SCHEDULE A ATTACHMENT, p6 printed Schedule B form, p7 the filer's TYPED SCHEDULE B ATTACHMENT. BOTH printed form pages are blank except for the handwritten words 'See attached schedule' across the first row, and both leave SUBTOTAL/TOTAL empty - so all itemization and the only Schedule A total live on the attachment sheets, which are headed in the filer's hand 'pg. 4 of 7' / 'pg. 5 of 7' / 'pg. 7 of 7, Bradley, June 20, 2006' (the p7 header is hand-dated 'June 20, 2001' - a filer slip for 2006, kept as observed and not corrected in any field). ADDRESSES ARE REDACTED, NOT MISSING: the attachment prints Address / City / State / ZIP column HEADERS and then a solid white block over the data - on p4 the block covers ZIP as well, on p5 the ZIP values survive. Because the block is a redaction rather than a filer omission, every donor_city/donor_state is blank with 'redacted' stated in the row note. No ZIP is recorded: it is not a contract field and it is neither a city nor a state. IN-KIND IS REAL AND FLAGGED: the attachment's foot carries the legend '* In Kind', and exactly three rows carry the trailing asterisk (all three are Kerri Nakamura / Salt Lake County: 78.90, 106.60 and 10.00). A FOURTH Nakamura row of 10.00 on 5/16/2006 does NOT carry the asterisk and is therefore left in_kind=false - the difference is on the page and was not smoothed over. In-kind rows DO count toward the printed total, which is why the gate closes with them included.
